mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market and weak economic growth, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (UNRATE > 6.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rates and elevated unemployment rates (UNRATE > 6.5%) signals an aggressive monetary policy response to economic weakness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 6.5% and FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST > 1000), increased residential construction activity signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST > 1000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 102, it signals robust manufacturing and supply chain activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO > 102, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0%, it signals a severe labor market contraction and economic distress, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (UNRATE > 7.0%), or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
